verdict.rationale: Account two-factor authentication is a fair question for a self-hosted Git service with user accounts, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 2FA, TOTP or authenticator apps. The security items cover only adjacent controls (user permission management, access control lists, audit logging, SAML SSO, OAuth2/OIDC), and these do not count as TOTP-based account protection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my account with two-factor authentication using a TOTP authenticator app
